tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[Euclidean point-distance functions]

Source: petersen:page-0113 ↗ def:pet-ch3-distance-function

1. ch3:3.2.6On $(\mathbb R^n,g_{\mathrm{can}})$, $r(x)=|x-y|$ is smooth on $\mathbb R^n\setminus \{ y\} $ with $|\nabla r|\equiv 1$. For two points $y,z$, $r(x)=\operatorname {dist}(x,\{ y,z\} )=\min \{ |x-y|,|x-z|\} $ is smooth away from $\{ y,z\} $ and the hyperplane equidistant from $y,z$. \end{example}
